subject: Nebula Marketplace — partner-issued promo credits (coordination & fulfillment)
messages:
From: Emma Liang <emma.liang@nebula.tools>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
Cc: marketplace-ops@nebula.tools
Date: 2025-11-10T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Partner credits batch for Nebula Marketplace launch

Hi Nikhil,

Hope you’re well — we’re targeting a soft launch of Nebula Marketplace on 2025-11-20 and would like to include a Redwood trial credit promotion for new signups coming through our marketplace flow.

Can Redwood issue a batch of partner-specific promo credits (redeemable during sign-up) totalling $10,000 (split into 100 codes of $100 each)? Key asks:
- Promo window: 2025-11-20 to 2026-02-20
- Per-account cap: $500
- Ability for codes to be single-use and to report redemptions by code and signup email

Attached is a short doc with marketplace partner requirements (nebula_promo_requirements.pdf). Let us know if you need a completed PO or an MPA amendment. We’d ideally have codes generated and a fulfillment link by 2025-11-13 so our engineering team can wire the redemption flow.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20m call if helpful.

Best,
Emma Liang
Partnerships
Nebula Tools

Attachment: nebula_promo_requirements.pdf (application/pdf, 78KB)

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
To: Emma Liang <emma.liang@nebula.tools>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-10T16:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Partner credits batch for Nebula Marketplace launch

Emma — thanks for the details and the doc. Quick clarifying questions so we can route approvals and set up reporting cleanly:

1) Attribution: do you want redemptions attributed to the marketplace via a code namespace (e.g., NEBULA-XXXX) or by a partner_id passed at signup? Namespace is simplest for fulfillment.
2) Billing/finance: do you have a PO number for the $10k promo pool or should we process as a partner marketing credit under our partner program (requires internal finance approval)?
3) Reporting cadence: do you need real-time webhook events for each redemption, or a daily CSV export will work?

I’ve attached our partner credit issuance template (partner_credit_template.csv) — please fill out the desired code prefix and PO (if available).

Tentative plan on our side: marissa_cole will sign off on partner marketing credit policy, aditya_rao will coordinate code generation & engineering handoff. If we get PO/mpa by EOD tomorrow we can target code delivery on 11/13.

Would you be able to confirm the code prefix and PO by EOD 11/11?

Thanks,
Nikhil
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachment: partner_credit_template.csv (text/csv, 3KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-11T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Partner credits batch for Nebula Marketplace launch — approval in principle

Looping in here — I reviewed the ask and approve up to $12k in partner marketing credits for Nebula under our standard partner promo policy, subject to:
- Signed partner promo agreement or PO referencing promo pool DEAL-8371
- Promo window and per-account caps documented in the agreement
- We receive the code namespace/prefix and target delivery date

I attached a draft promo agreement (promo_agreement_draft.pdf) that has the standard indemnities and reporting obligations. If the partner signs the draft or sends a PO we can finalize and generate codes.

Next steps for internal owners:
- Nikhil: confirm whether Nebula will provide a PO or sign the draft agreement.
- Aditya: prepare code generation script and confirm required fields for redemption payload (signup email, code, partner_id).

Marissa
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachment: promo_agreement_draft.pdf (application/pdf, 92KB)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-12T11:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Nebula credits — engineering & reporting plan

Quick update from engineering side: we can generate a namespaced batch (NEBULA-XXXXXX) and produce a CSV with code, value, created_at, and redemption_status. Two questions for the partner integration:
- What identifier will be passed to us at signup? (email is fine; partner_id would be preferred for deduping)
- Do you want a webhook per redemption to a Nebula endpoint, or will you rely on a daily CSV export? We can support both; webhooks need a signed URL and about 1 business day to enable.

Assuming we get the PO/MPA and the prefix by EOD 11/12, we can generate the codes and upload the CSV to the Drive link and notify your marketplace ops contact.

Aditya
Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference
